name: pleasantries

source.quote: Put in the tutor hub for her to answer

intro: Thank you for catching the 'be credited' wording! These 5 quick questions help the app give the student credit for pleasantries the right way. Tap an answer; add a note if you like.

questions.ask: Should these count as pleasantries the student gets credit for? sa7tain → 3ala albak · ya3tik el-3aafie → allah y3afeek · shukran → 3afwan · aasef · marhaba → ahlan · kifak → tamam / el7amdilla · 7amdilla 3al salameh → allah ysalmak
questions.note: If you want to add or remove some, tap 'It depends' and write them.

questions.ask: Should he get credit ONLY when he gives the right reply to yours (for example you say sa7tain, he says 3ala albik), and not when he starts a pleasantry himself?
In your note you wrote '3ala albek / 2albek*'. Are both spellings fine (3ala albek and 3ala 2albek)?
questions.note: Your note on the Oct 10 lesson, 27:31: "3ala albek/2albek* sa7tain response. should be credited for knowing pleasantries responses like sa7tain, ya3tik el-3aafie, aasef, etc."

questions.ask: If he says the masculine form to you (3ala albak instead of 3ala albik), should it still count as right?
Should a pleasantry count like a normal vocabulary word (and not as its own separate 'social phrases' score)?
